reviews.evidence: The patch only replaces an example comment in Material's snack-bar.md. This package does not contain that markdown or the snack-bar-annotated-component example.

The patch removes the word either from Material's input.md. The sentence still says an error shows when the control is invalid and touched, or the parent form is submitted. This package does not contain that markdown.
The patch renames the documented range-thumb selectors in Material's slider.md and says the start thumb cannot exceed the end thumb. This package has neither that markdown nor matSliderStartThumb.

The patch changes the documented Page Up step from 10 steps to 10% of max. The owned legacy slider still calls _increment(10), which adds step times 10. The markdown is not in this package, and this review does not change that behavior.
The patch tells readers to install the date-fns, Luxon, and Moment adapters with ng add. This package does not contain that markdown.
The patch deletes a docs sentence that told chip users to announce removal with LiveAnnouncer. This package does not contain that markdown, and the owned chip sources do not mention LiveAnnouncer.
The patch adds Material Symbols guidance and switches the upstream dev-app font class. This package does not contain the dev-app or icon.md.
The patch inserts the word is in CDK scrolling.md. This package does not contain that markdown.
The patch replaces the MDC progress-bar setup guide with a link to the public docs. This package does not contain that README.
The patch moves value="1.5" from mat-slider onto the inner input in slider.md. This package does not contain that markdown.
The patch removes platform-browser-dynamic from upstream example Bazel targets. The only added line is an input target on the sidenav example. This package has no Bazel example graph.
The patch updates expansion examples to current MatExpansionModule, OnPush, and viewChild, plus expansion.md. Those example files are not in this package.
The patch refreshes button-toggle examples, including hide-selection-indicator checkboxes, and button-toggle.md. Those files are not in this package.
The patch rewords tooltip.md. It still documents below as the default position, before/after for RTL, a 1500ms mobile hide, and aria-describedby. This package does not contain that markdown.
The patch edits toolbar examples, the upstream toolbar demo, and toolbar.md. This package does not contain those files.

limitations: The other 47 docs-build SHAs were not read.
Seed dispositions for these SHAs stay open.
